blocks.text: Open-source workflow automation with code-level flexibility

n8n is the automation platform for teams that want visual workflow building with the escape hatch of writing code when needed. It is open-source and self-hostable, meaning your data never leaves your infrastructure - a requirement for many regulated industries and security-conscious organizations.

The hybrid approach - visual builder plus code nodes - is n8n's superpower. Start with drag-and-drop modules for standard integrations, then drop in JavaScript or Python when you need custom logic, API calls, or data transformations that pre-built modules cannot handle.

Self-hosting n8n means no per-workflow pricing limits. Run as many workflows as your server can handle, process as much data as you need, and store credentials on your own infrastructure. For high-volume automation use cases, the economics are dramatically better than SaaS alternatives.
Full source code access with MIT license and self-hosting option
Drag-and-drop modules with JavaScript and Python code nodes
Run on your own infrastructure for data sovereignty
Growing library of pre-built nodes for popular services
Built-in AI agent and LLM nodes for AI-powered workflows
Configurable error workflows with retry and fallback logic

For clients with data sensitivity requirements or high-volume automation needs, n8n is our recommendation. The ability to self-host and write custom code gives technical teams the control they need without giving up the visual workflow experience.
Our team can integrate n8n into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
